recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **All-purpose flour**: 300 g ([**0:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=42s))
- **Cornstarch**: 18 g *(Aaron's secret to mimicking soft cake flour)* ([**6:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=371s))
- **Vegetable oil**: 350 mL ([**2:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=164s))
- **Brown sugar**: 220 g ([**3:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=192s))
- **Granulated sugar**: 200 g ([**3:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=199s))
- **Large eggs**: 4 ([**3:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=199s))
- **Grated carrots**: 313 g ([**4:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=289s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 29.5 mL ([**4:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=263s))
- **Baking powder**: 7 g ([**1:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=74s))
- **Baking soda**: 5 g ([**1:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=74s))
- **Fine sea salt**: 3 g ([**2:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=126s))
- **Cinnamon**: 5 mL ([**2:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=138s))
- **Ginger**: 5 mL ([**2:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=138s))
- **Ground nutmeg**: 10 mL ([**8:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=495s))
- **Ground cardamom**: 7.5 mL ([**8:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=513s))
- **Golden raisins**: 100 g *(Added by special request)* ([**0:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=15s))
- **Mixed nuts**: 100 g total (A 50/50 blend of chopped hazelnuts and walnuts) ([**4:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=289s))

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Cold cream cheese**: 440 g ([**11:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=683s))
- **Butter**: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=719s))
- **Powdered sugar**: 400 g *(Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness)* ([**13:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=801s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL ([**12:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=770s))
- **Walnuts**: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) ([**17:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=1032s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Cold cream cheese: 440 g (11:23)
  • Butter: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) (11:59)
  • Powdered sugar: 400 g (Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness) (13:21)
  • Vanilla paste: 5 mL (12:50)
  • Walnuts: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) (17:12)
recipe-section-2.title: For the Cream Cheese Frosting & Topping

recipe-section-4.markdown: - Preheat your oven to 175 °C ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=631s)). Take a standard 22.9 × 33 cm baking dish and line the entire bottom and sides completely with parchment paper ([**4:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=257s)). Use kitchen shears to snip the corners so the paper folds and lays perfectly flat ([**9:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=594s)).
recipe-section-4.html: • Preheat your oven to 175 °C (10:31). Take a standard 22.9 × 33 cm baking dish and line the entire bottom and sides completely with parchment paper (4:17). Use kitchen shears to snip the corners so the paper folds and lays perfectly flat (9:54).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Prep the Oven and Baking Pan
recipe-section-4.heading_html: Step 1: Prep the Oven and Baking Pan

recipe-section-5.markdown: - Set up your kitchen scale ([**0:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=50s)). Weigh out and whisk together 300 g of all-purpose flour, 18 g of cornstarch, 7 g of baking powder, 5 g of baking soda, and 3 g of fine sea salt ([**0:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=42s)). Whisk in your dry spices: cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cardamom ([**2:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=138s)).
recipe-section-5.html: • Set up your kitchen scale (0:50). Weigh out and whisk together 300 g of all-purpose flour, 18 g of cornstarch, 7 g of baking powder, 5 g of baking soda, and 3 g of fine sea salt (0:42). Whisk in your dry spices: cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cardamom (2:18).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Mix the Dry Ingredients

recipe-section-6.markdown: - Pour 350 mL of vegetable oil directly into the bowl ([**2:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=156s)). Add the brown sugar, granulated sugar, four eggs, and 29.5 mL of vanilla paste ([**3:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=192s)). Add your 313 g of freshly grated carrots, the 100 g nut blend, and the golden raisins ([**4:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=289s)).
recipe-section-6.html: • Pour 350 mL of vegetable oil directly into the bowl (2:36). Add the brown sugar, granulated sugar, four eggs, and 29.5 mL of vanilla paste (3:12). Add your 313 g of freshly grated carrots, the 100 g nut blend, and the golden raisins (4:49).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Combine the Wet Elements & Inclusions
recipe-section-6.heading_html: Step 3: Combine the Wet Elements & Inclusions

recipe-section-7.markdown: - Mix everything together gently using a hand spoon or spatula ([**5:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=314s)). Scrape the absolute bottom of the bowl and drag it up to ensure no dry pockets remain ([**7:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=439s)). *Do not use an electric mixer here; carrot cake batter is incredibly easy to over-mix!* ([**5:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=314s))
recipe-section-7.html: • Mix everything together gently using a hand spoon or spatula (5:14). Scrape the absolute bottom of the bowl and drag it up to ensure no dry pockets remain (7:19). Do not use an electric mixer here; carrot cake batter is incredibly easy to over-mix! (5:14)
recipe-section-7.title: Step 4: Mix the Batter Carefully by Hand
recipe-section-7.heading_html: Step 4: Mix the Batter Carefully by Hand

recipe-section-8.markdown: - Pour your smooth, rich batter into your fully lined 9x13 pan ([**10:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=623s)). Bake at 175 °C for exactly 30 minutes ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=631s)). Let the cake cool completely before attempting to frost it.
recipe-section-8.html: • Pour your smooth, rich batter into your fully lined 9x13 pan (10:23). Bake at 175 °C for exactly 30 minutes (10:31). Let the cake cool completely before attempting to frost it.
recipe-section-8.title: Step 5: Bake and Cool

recipe-section-9.markdown: - While the cake cools, place 440 g of cold cream cheese and 250 g of slightly chilled butter into a clean bowl ([**11:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=683s)). Mix on a low speed with a hand mixer to combine them ([**12:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=739s)). Blend in 5 mL of vanilla paste and 400 g of powdered sugar until the texture is completely smooth ([**12:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=770s)).
recipe-section-9.html: • While the cake cools, place 440 g of cold cream cheese and 250 g of slightly chilled butter into a clean bowl (11:23). Mix on a low speed with a hand mixer to combine them (12:19). Blend in 5 mL of vanilla paste and 400 g of powdered sugar until the texture is completely smooth (12:50).
recipe-section-9.title: Step 6: Whip up the Frosting

recipe-section-10.markdown: - Pour your cream cheese frosting smoothly over the top of the sheet cake ([**15:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=901s)). Use your spatula to create texturized, elegant "sideways swoops" in the frosting while ensuring no cake peeks through ([**16:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=985s)). Roughly chop a handful of walnuts into large, chunky pieces and sprinkle them generously over the top ([**17:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=1040s)).
recipe-section-10.html: • Pour your cream cheese frosting smoothly over the top of the sheet cake (15:01). Use your spatula to create texturized, elegant "sideways swoops" in the frosting while ensuring no cake peeks through (16:25). Roughly chop a handful of walnuts into large, chunky pieces and sprinkle them generously over the top (17:20).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 7: Frost and Garnish
